targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM station s
WHERE s.statut = 'active'
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}');

SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM charging_session cs
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE cs.end_time IS NULL
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}');

SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM device d
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE (d.last_seen IS NULL OR d.last_seen < now() - interval '5 minutes')
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}');

SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM alerte a
LEFT JOIN charging_session cs ON cs.id_session = a.id_session
LEFT JOIN emplacement session_emplacement ON session_emplacement.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN capteur_data cd ON cd.id_data = a.id_data
LEFT JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
LEFT JOIN emplacement sensor_emplacement ON sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = COALESCE(session_emplacement.id_emplacement, sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement)
LEFT JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
LEFT JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE a.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'resolue', 'closed', 'fermee')
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}');

WITH latest_power AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.id_device) d.id_device, cd.valeur
  FROM capteur_data cd
  JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
  JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
  JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
  JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
  JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
  WHERE c.type = 'power' AND $__timeFilter(cd.timestamp)
    AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
    AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
    AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
  ORDER BY d.id_device, cd.timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valeur), 0)::double precision AS value FROM latest_power;

WITH latest_session_energy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (st.id_session) st.id_session, st.energie_kwh
  FROM session_telemetry st
  JOIN charging_session cs ON cs.id_session = st.id_session
  JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
  JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
  JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
  WHERE st.timestamp >= date_trunc('day', now())
    AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
    AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
    AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
  ORDER BY st.id_session, st.timestamp DESC
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(energie_kwh), 0)::double precision AS value FROM latest_session_energy;

SELECT cs.start_time AS debut, COALESCE(u.pseudo, '-') AS utilisateur, COALESCE(r.reference_code, '-') AS code_reservation, s.nom AS station, b.nom AS borne, e.numero AS emplacement, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - cs.start_time)) / 60)::integer AS duree_min, latest_tel.courant, latest_tel.tension, latest_tel.energie_kwh
FROM charging_session cs
JOIN reservation r ON r.id_reservation = cs.id_reservation
LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.id_user = r.id_user
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT st.courant, st.tension, st.energie_kwh
  FROM session_telemetry st
  WHERE st.id_session = cs.id_session
  ORDER BY st.timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) latest_tel ON true
WHERE cs.end_time IS NULL
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY cs.start_time;

SELECT s.nom AS station, s.localisation AS localisation, s.statut, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id_device) AS devices, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id_device) FILTER (WHERE d.last_seen IS NULL OR d.last_seen < now() - interval '5 minutes') AS esp32_hors_ligne, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id_session) AS sessions_en_cours, MAX(d.last_seen) AS dernier_signal
FROM station s
LEFT JOIN borne b ON b.id_station = s.id_station
LEFT JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_borne = b.id_borne
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_emplacement = e.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN charging_session cs ON cs.id_emplacement = e.id_emplacement AND cs.end_time IS NULL
WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
GROUP BY s.id_station, s.nom, s.localisation, s.statut
ORDER BY esp32_hors_ligne DESC, sessions_en_cours DESC, station;

SELECT a.date AS time, a.type, a.niveau_severite, a.status, COALESCE(s.nom, '-') AS station, COALESCE(b.nom, '-') AS borne, COALESCE(e.numero::text, '-') AS emplacement, a.message
FROM alerte a
LEFT JOIN charging_session cs ON cs.id_session = a.id_session
LEFT JOIN emplacement session_emplacement ON session_emplacement.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN capteur_data cd ON cd.id_data = a.id_data
LEFT JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
LEFT JOIN emplacement sensor_emplacement ON sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = COALESCE(session_emplacement.id_emplacement, sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement)
LEFT JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
LEFT JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.date)
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY a.date DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT dcl.timestamp AS time, s.nom AS station, b.nom AS borne, e.numero AS emplacement, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.mac_address, ''), e.numero::text) AS slot, dcl.action, dcl.status, dcl.message, dcl.id_session AS session_id
FROM device_command_log dcl
JOIN device d ON d.id_device = dcl.id_device
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE $__timeFilter(dcl.timestamp)
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY dcl.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

list.definition: SELECT id_station::text AS __value, nom AS __text FROM station ORDER BY nom;
list.label: Station
list.name: station
list.query: SELECT id_station::text AS __value, nom AS __text FROM station ORDER BY nom;

list.definition: SELECT b.id_borne::text AS __value, s.nom || ' / ' || b.nom AS __text FROM borne b JOIN station s ON s.id_station = b.id_station WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_station::text = '${station:raw}') ORDER BY s.nom, b.numero;
list.label: Borne
list.name: borne
list.query: SELECT b.id_borne::text AS __value, s.nom || ' / ' || b.nom AS __text FROM borne b JOIN station s ON s.id_station = b.id_station WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_station::text = '${station:raw}') ORDER BY s.nom, b.numero;

list.definition: SELECT e.id_emplacement::text AS __value, s.nom || ' / ' || b.nom || ' / emplacement ' || e.numero::text AS __text FROM emplacement e JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_station::text = '${station:raw}') AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}') ORDER BY s.nom, b.numero, e.numero;
list.label: Emplacement
list.name: emplacement
list.query: SELECT e.id_emplacement::text AS __value, s.nom || ' / ' || b.nom || ' / emplacement ' || e.numero::text AS __text FROM emplacement e JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_station::text = '${station:raw}') AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}') ORDER BY s.nom, b.numero, e.numero;
